subject.title: [Bug]: Discord media uploads lose content-type and animated images lose frames

question: Should maintainers keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41265 as the canonical fix after refresh, or replace it with a narrow current-main branch?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and has an open closing PR, but that PR is conflicting and has media-contract/proof blockers that automation should not resolve from the issue alone.

options.title: Refresh and narrow the linked PR
options.body: Keep the contributor path canonical, update it to current main, remove or explicitly approve broader media/API behavior, and require live Discord proof before merge.

options.title: Replace with a narrow fix
options.body: Open a fresh current-main branch that credits the source work and fixes only the Discord/media paths needed for this issue.

options.title: Defer for product review
options.body: Leave the issue open until maintainers decide the permanent media preservation and over-cap delivery contract.

recommendation.title: Refresh and narrow the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep the contributor path canonical, update it to current main, remove or explicitly approve broader media/API behavior, and require live Discord proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest feature-history owner for the Discord media send path and owner-boundary shape involved in this choice.
